review_type: official-source triage, technical/product confidence review; not attorney legal review

federal_sources_checked.finding: National federal court forms can be used in all federal courts; local courts maintain local forms.
IRS publishes latest versions of forms, instructions, and publications; official tax workflows should route to IRS current pages.
Trademark forms are accessed through USPTO systems and may require MyUSPTO/two-step login; PDFs/previews are not filing substitutes.
Registration depends on business structure and business location; state/local routing is required.

arizona_sources_triaged.finding: Official Arizona Corporation Commission LLC forms include Articles of Organization, foreign registration, statutory agent changes, and statutory agent acceptance.
ACC corporation forms page says forms are fillable PDFs and documents must be submitted with a cover sheet.
Arizona Judicial Branch provides court forms/instructions and recommends consulting an attorney for filings.
ADOR TPT page lists official business/tax forms and encourages online filing for faster processing and fewer errors.
ADOT/MVD provides official forms library for vehicle matters.
Secretary of State page says the advance directive registry moved to AzHDR effective September 24, 2021.

important_boundary: This supplement verifies routing/source posture only. It does not validate individual template legal sufficiency, current statutes, county/court local rules, or filing acceptance.
